remarks: Stunning Colonial in Prime Norwalk Location! Welcome to this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial located in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods. This home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience, with spacious living areas and thoughtful updates throughout. Step inside to a bright and inviting layout featuring generous room sizes, excellent flow, and plenty of natural light. The main level includes a well-appointed kitchen, formal dining area, and comfortable living spaces ideal for everyday living or entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find four spacious bedrooms, including a lovely primary suite. Enjoy the outdoors in the private backyard, perfect for relaxing, gardening, or hosting family and friends. A two-car garage provides added convenience and storage. Situated in a wonderful area of Norwalk, this home offers easy access to schools, shopping, parks, major work centers, and highway connections, making daily life and commuting effortless. This stunning Colonial truly has it all-space, location, and lifestyle. Don't miss this opportunity!
